notes.title: Fall of Porcupine | Patch #8 | 1.1.13
notes.notes:
Dear Porcupine-Fans,
we have released another Patch for Fall of Porcupine on Steam, in which we fixed some issues and bringing some adjustments. 

Find a detailed list below:
Fixed
 Fixed Maggys comic bug on some paths
 Fixed Mia bubble scale on end of day 6
 Fixed negative medication minigame values
 Fixed some layering issues
 Fixed snowball fight soft lock
 Fixed snow layer issue
 Fixed wrong card game tutorial text

Added
 Added MP cost display to fight abilities

Miscellaneous
 Potential scene change soft lock fix
 Updated day two events
 Updated the localisation files


Please keep reporting any issues or providing us feedback!
Thank you for your ongoing support! Please keep it up!
